name: Peter Sarnak
note: A leading analytic number theorist at Princeton and the Institute for Advanced Study. His advisor-student network reaches three Top 100 researchers, the strongest single genealogy tie to the directory.

name: Olli Järviniemi
note: A young Finnish number theorist (PhD Turku 2023), connected through close advisor-student ties to Kaisa Matomäki and the Turku school.

name: Mattia Cafferata
note: An Italian number theorist (PhD Ferrara 2019) in the analytic prime-number tradition, linked to the directory through shared advisors.

name: Stefan Neumann
note: A number theorist (PhD Stuttgart 2006) tied to the German analytic number theory lineage that runs through the directory.

name: Kam Hung Yau
note: A number theorist (PhD UNSW 2020) working on exponential sums, connected to the Sydney analytic number theory group.

name: Christian Bagshaw
note: A recent number theory PhD (UNSW 2025), connected to the directory through the Sydney analytic number theory school.

name: Taiyu Li
note: A number theorist (PhD Shandong 2012) from the Shandong analytic number theory school that anchors much of the Chinese Goldbach work.

name: Sofia Lindqvist
note: A number theorist (PhD Oxford 2019) working on additive combinatorics and the distribution of primes, reaching the directory through the Oxford lineage.

name: Timothy Trudgian
note: An analytic number theorist (PhD Oxford 2010) known for explicit estimates related to the zeros of the zeta function, tied to the Oxford and Australian schools.

name: Douglas Woodall
note: A combinatorialist and number theorist (PhD Nottingham 1969) connected to the directory through advisor-student ties.

name: Dorian Goldfeld
note: An analytic number theorist at Columbia (PhD 1969), known for work on L-functions and the Gauss class number problem, linked to the directory's lineage.

name: Michael Filaseta
note: A number theorist (PhD Illinois 1984) working on polynomials and primes, connected through shared advisors with the directory.
